title: Airy Light Italian Chicken Pasta
description: A malty and shaggy Italian dish featuring basil leaves, made with sous-vide chicken and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for a light dinner
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the chicken breast pieces with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Seal the chicken in a sous-vide bag and cook for 2 hours
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions
Drain the pasta and set it aside
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the olive oil
Chop the fresh basil leaves and add them to the pasta
Add the cooked chicken to the pasta and toss to combine
Top the pasta with grated parmesan cheese and serve hot
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
